note.explanation: Biostatistics applies statistical methods to biological sciences. It helps organise and understand data so people can make informed decisions, for example in public health. The mean is the sum of all values divided by the number of values; the median is the middle value when the data is ordered; and the mode is the most frequently occurring value. A bar chart uses bars to show the values of different categories.
examples: For 3, 5, 5, 8, the median is (5 + 5) ÷ 2 = 5 and the mode is 5.
note.checkAnswer: The mean is 6; the median is 6; the mode is 6.
note.simple: Biostatistics helps us use data about living things and health. Mean is the average, median is the middle, and mode is the most common value.
note.checkQuestion: For the data set 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, what are the mean, median, and mode?
note.title: Biostatistics and ways to summarise data
steps: Order the values from smallest to largest when finding the median.
For an odd number of values, select the single middle value; for an even number, average the two middle values.
To find the mean, add all values and divide by the number of values.
To find the mode, identify the value or values occurring most frequently.
For a bar chart, place categories on the horizontal axis and show each category's value with a bar.
note.answer: Biostatistics applies statistical methods to biological sciences. Mean, median, mode, and bar charts help describe and interpret data.

written.text: Q11.2. Discuss the differences between mean, median, and mode. Include examples where each measure is most appropriate to use.
written.finalAnswer: The mean is the sum of all values divided by the number of values; it is useful for numerical data without extreme values. The median is the middle value in ordered data (or the average of the two middle values for an even number of values); it is useful when extreme values could distort the mean. The mode is the most frequently occurring value; it is useful for finding the most common value or category.

explain.title: What biostatistics does
explain.body: Biostatistics applies statistical methods to biological sciences. It helps people use biological and health data to understand problems and make decisions.

explain.title: Mean: share the total equally
explain.body: To find the mean, add all the values and divide by the number of values. It is the arithmetic average.

explain.title: Median: find the middle
explain.body: Put the values in order. If there is an odd number of values, use the single middle value. If there is an even number, average the two middle values.

explain.title: Mode: find what occurs most
explain.body: The mode is the value that occurs most frequently. A data set may have more than one mode, or no mode if no value is repeated.

explain.title: Bar charts show category values
explain.body: A bar chart displays values for categories. Usually, categories go on the horizontal axis and values go on the vertical axis; each bar's height or length represents its category's value.

mistakes: Finding the median before ordering the values.
Choosing one middle value when the data set has an even number of values instead of averaging the two middle values.
Dividing the sum by the wrong number of values when calculating the mean.
Calling the most frequent value the mean or median instead of the mode.
Forgetting that a data set can have two modes or no mode.
Leaving the axes or title unlabeled on a bar chart, or drawing bars that do not match the data values.
